wikipedia.title: Rush Creek Wind Project
wikipedia.extract: The Rush Creek Wind Project is a 600 megawatt (MW) wind facility in eastern Colorado, located west of the town of Limon.  It increased the wind generating capacity in the state by 20% when it came online in late 2018.  The facility is financed, owned, and operated by Xcel Energy,  the largest public utility in the state. The project was developed primarily for its numerous economic benefits since Xcel previously met the minimum 30% requirement of Colorado's 2020 renewable portfolio standard.
